comment: The LHR is described as the PHSP's 'primary source of person-level clinical data'. In transitional states, surveillance data flows will precede a functioning LHR by years; facility-direct notification will remain the dominant channel. Stating the LHR as primary source risks implementers de-prioritising direct reporting channels or deferring surveillance investment pending the LHR.

public.text: The LHR is described as the PHSP's 'primary source of person-level clinical data'. In transitional states, surveillance data flows will precede a functioning LHR by years; facility-direct notification will remain the dominant channel. public.suggestedRevision: Reframe: facility-direct case notification is the primary channel in early and transitional maturity states; LHR-derived reporting is the target-state channel that progressively reduces parallel reporting burden. Make the transition explicit rather than implied.
